SELECT freeboard_no , title , content , user_id , DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reg_dt , DATE_FORMAT(mod_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS mod_dt , inquire_cnt , like_count , hate_count FROM seinfo_freeboard_posts WHERE 1=1
AND ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND ( content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY 1 DESC

select count(*) from seinfo_notice where notice_type = 'N'
and ( notice_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR notice_contents LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND ( notice_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND ( notice_contents LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

select a.notice_type ,a.notice_no ,a.notice_title ,a.notice_contents ,a.inquire_cnt ,a.mfile_group_id ,date_format(a.reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as reg_dt ,a.reg_user_id ,a.mod_dt ,a.mod_user_id ,( select notice_no from seinfo_notice where notice_no < a.notice_no and notice_type = 'N' order by notice_no desc limit 1 ) as prev_notice_no ,( select notice_title from seinfo_notice where notice_no < a.notice_no and notice_type = 'N' order by notice_no desc limit 1 ) as prev_notice_title ,( select notice_no from seinfo_notice where notice_no > a.notice_no and notice_type = 'N' and notice_type = 'N' order by notice_no asc limit 1 ) as next_notice_no ,( select notice_title from seinfo_notice where notice_no > a.notice_no and notice_type = 'N' order by notice_no asc limit 1 ) as next_notice_title from seinfo_notice a where notice_no = #{noticeNo} and notice_type = 'N'
select mfile_group_id as mfile_grp_id from seinfo_notice where notice_no = #{noticeNo} and notice_type = 'N'
mapper.delete: delete from seinfo_notice where notice_no = #{noticeNo} and notice_type = 'N'
